title: Catalog API pagination contract selection and next-page UI behavior
purpose: Proposed handoff assembled from source-linked outcomes; human source review and approval required.

scope.text: GET /v1/items returns a JSON object with an items array and next_cursor string.
UI must support moving to the next page.
GET /v1/items returns a top-level JSON array and uses page and page_size query parameters.

requirements.text: GET /v1/items returns a JSON object with an items array and next_cursor string.
UI must support moving to the next page.
GET /v1/items returns a top-level JSON array and uses page and page_size query parameters.

stories.text: Only if an authorized human selects alternative ALT-CATALOG-DRAFT-A in unresolved decision DEC-CATALOG-API-CONTRACT: GET /v1/items returns a JSON object with an items array and next_cursor string.
acceptance_criteria: Only if an authorized human selects alternative ALT-CATALOG-DRAFT-A in unresolved decision DEC-CATALOG-API-CONTRACT: The response body for GET /v1/items is a JSON object with an `items` property whose value is an array and a `next_cursor` property whose value is a string.

stories.text: Only if an authorized human selects alternative ALT-CATALOG-DRAFT-A in unresolved decision DEC-CATALOG-API-CONTRACT: UI must support moving to the next page.
acceptance_criteria: Only if an authorized human selects alternative ALT-CATALOG-DRAFT-A in unresolved decision DEC-CATALOG-API-CONTRACT: The UI provides an action that moves the user from the current catalog page to the next catalog page; after that action, the UI displays the items from the next page.

stories.text: Only if an authorized human selects alternative ALT-CATALOG-DRAFT-B in unresolved decision DEC-CATALOG-API-CONTRACT: GET /v1/items returns a top-level JSON array and uses page and page_size query parameters.
acceptance_criteria: Only if an authorized human selects alternative ALT-CATALOG-DRAFT-B in unresolved decision DEC-CATALOG-API-CONTRACT: A GET /v1/items request uses `page` and `page_size` as query parameters.
Only if an authorized human selects alternative ALT-CATALOG-DRAFT-B in unresolved decision DEC-CATALOG-API-CONTRACT: The response body for GET /v1/items is a top-level JSON array.

open_questions: Under draft A, after GET /v1/items returns a `next_cursor`, how must the next-page request supply that cursor back to GET /v1/items?
Under draft A, how should clients interpret the response when `next_cursor` is an empty string, absent, or null, and what indicates there is no next page?
Under draft A, which user action or actions must trigger next-page movement, and what UI state must be observable before and after the items list updates?
Under draft B, how must `page` and `page_size` query parameters be supplied, validated, and bounded for GET /v1/items?
Under draft B, how should clients interpret a top-level JSON array response to determine pagination exhaustion or error when `page` and `page_size` are supplied?
Under draft B, which user actions or UI behaviors, if any, apply when the API returns a top-level JSON array?

Which catalog API contract should govern GET /v1/items: draft A's JSON object with `items` array and `next_cursor` string, or draft B's top-level JSON array with `page` and `page_size` query parameters?
Who has the authority to select the authoritative catalog API contract when neither draft is approved?
Who owns the catalog API contract decision?
What is the delivery date for the selected catalog API contract and its dependent UI next-page support?
